comment: * Collection of common constants for accessibility magnification.

variables.name: PERSISTED_SCALE_MIN_VALUE
variables.comment:
* The min value for the magnification persisted scale. We assume if the scale is lower than
     * the min value, there will be no obvious magnification effect.

variables.name: SCALE_MIN_VALUE
variables.comment: Minimum supported value for magnification scale.

variables.name: SCALE_MAX_VALUE
variables.comment: Maximum supported value for magnification scale. Default of 8.0.
